units: Count findings and affected words separately. Source fragments, English uses and display groups are distinct.

definitions.Critical: Identity/source corruption, fabricated human approval or widespread severe semantic deception backed by concrete evidence.
definitions.Major: Material wrong meaning/POS/merge, unsupported core addition or important independent use silently omitted. Give source/evidence and domain.
definitions.Minor: Local evidence alignment or scope issue with limited impact; not wholesale mistranslation.
definitions.teaching_preference: Multiple lexically defensible wordings/layerings/orders without evidence one is wrong. Not counted as error.
definitions.tracked_external_gap: A dictionary use absent from original is explicitly listed as unadopted candidate with coverage warning. Remains unresolved adoption, not silently omitted original or automatically repaired source.
definitions.same_systematic_major: At least 2 distinct words in the fresh100 or newly introduced regression changes exhibit the same causal Major mapping/POS/merge/omission defect. Known historical source gaps explicitly tracked are reported separately, not hidden or relabeled as passed.

A_requires_all: All 500 have explicit V4 semantic re-evaluation, all historical48 states accounted, all fresh100 independently source-first reviewed.
100% unique formal IDs, immutable original fields/spans, full source-reference coverage and valid one-to-many annotations; no invented human approval/adoption.

C3 import use/evidence correction and indicate evidence/scope correction verified in isolated candidates; management gap explicitly tracked as unadopted external candidate and incomplete coverage, not declared adopted/resolved source.
Zero unresolved confirmed Critical or current-candidate Major after independently justified corrections; no same_systematic_major.
Fresh100 initial evidence-supported current-candidate Major at most 3 and Minor at most 10; any Major has explicit correction and validation, not a risk-label downgrade.
No new confirmed loss of an originally correct use from regression changes, and no overall POS or source-mapping defect.
External additions and all unapproved data remain AI candidates. Historical unknown evidence stays pending; compression is never sufficient evidence.
B_if: Any A requirement fails but concrete local rule/evidence/data corrections can address it, including repeated Major of one type. Incomplete evidence/review also B with explicit checkpoint/failure, not fabricated pass.
C_if: Evidence proves a fundamental unrepairable-by-local-rule method defect: source/identity loss or systematic semantic/POS failures across at least 3 strata, and no adequate local repair while retaining meanings. Mere historical risk labels or preference differences do not establish C.
first_memory_audit: Report average/median/max and count over3 core groups; examine all over3 individually. No hard compression gate and no arbitrary deletion to meet counts.
comparison_baseline: Existing500 uses actual C2 candidates informed by C1 RULES_V3, including its p6c2-rules-v4 project label. Do not mislabel it as a pure V3 controlled experiment. Fresh100 has no matched V3 arm; report no invented improvement percentage.
model_identity: Record visible configuration. Unknown backend means independent context only, not proven different model.
authorization: No bulk4832, formal-data write, SQLite/Notion/progress/UI/Japanese modification, publication or Git mutation in this task.
freeze_method: SHA256 of this file and RULES_V4_REVISED.md saved in PROTOCOL_SEAL.json before generation/review results; immutable thereafter.
